Community Package Disclaimer This package is developed by a non-core ODS team and is community-driven. While it follows ODS design tokens and guidelines, it is maintained independently from the official ODS React UI Kit. For official ODS components, please use @telekom-ods/react-ui-kit. This guide walks you through integrating ODS design tokens with Tailwind CSS v4, enabling you to build applications using Tailwind utilities powered by the OneExperience Design System. Overview The @telekom-ods/tailwind-theme package provides ready-to-use theme presets that integrate ODS design tokens with Tailwind CSS v4. This allows you to use Tailwind's utility-first approach while maintaining design consistency with the ODS design system. Prerequisites Before you begin, ensure you have: Node.js (v16 or higher) A project set up with a modern build tool (Next.js, Vite, etc.) Access to the Magenta CICD JFrog platform (for package installation) Installation 1. Set up your .npmrc file Configure your .npmrc file with the following: @telekom-ods:registry=https://artifactory.devops.telekom.de/artifactory/api/npm/one-design-system-npm/ //artifactory.devops.telekom.de/artifactory/api/npm/one-design-system-npm/:_authToken=YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN Copy If you don't have an authentication token, follow the steps in the Web Get Started guide to generate one. 2. Install required packages Install Tailwind CSS v4, the ODS Tailwind theme, and ODS design tokens: npm install tailwindcss@^4.2.4 @tailwindcss/postcss@^4.2.4 npm install @telekom-ods/tailwind-theme @telekom-ods/design-tokens Copy or with yarn: yarn add tailwindcss@^4.2.4 @tailwindcss/postcss@^4.2.4 yarn add @telekom-ods/tailwind-theme @telekom-ods/design-tokens Copy 3. Configure Tailwind Please refer to the Tailwind CSS documentation for detailed configuration instructions. Choosing a Theme Preset The @telekom-ods/tailwind-theme package provides three preset configurations. Choose the one that best fits your project needs: recommended.css — ODS + Minimal Tailwind Reset (Recommended) Replaces Tailwind's color palette, breakpoints, and radius scale with ODS equivalents while keeping all other Tailwind defaults (spacing, typography, shadows, etc.). Best for: Most ODS projects — you get ODS design system colors and breakpoints with the full ergonomics of Tailwind's spacing and typography helpers. Reset scope: --color-*, --background-color-*, --text-color-*, --border-color-*, --radius-*, --breakpoint-* strict.css — ODS Only Removes all Tailwind v4 default namespaces. Only ODS-defined utilities are available. Structural utilities (flex, grid, display, etc.) remain unaffected. Best for: Greenfield ODS projects where Tailwind defaults must not leak into the design. Reset scope: Colors, spacing, typography, radius, border widths, shadows, blur, opacity, motion, transforms, z-index, aspect ratio, columns, container. full.css — Full Tailwind + ODS Keeps all Tailwind defaults and layers ODS tokens on top. Both Tailwind colors (bg-blue-500) and ODS semantic tokens (bg-accent) work simultaneously. Best for: Projects migrating incrementally to ODS, or teams that need both design systems. Reset scope: --breakpoint-* and --radius-* only (to resolve naming conflicts) Setup 1. Import the theme in your global CSS Create or update your global CSS file (e.g., globals.css, app.css, or index.css): @import "tailwindcss"; @import "@telekom-ods/tailwind-theme/recommended.css"; Copy Replace recommended.css with your chosen preset: @telekom-ods/tailwind-theme/strict.css for ODS only @telekom-ods/tailwind-theme/full.css for full Tailwind + ODS 2. Import the global CSS in your application For Next.js: Import in your root layout (app/layout.tsx or pages/_app.tsx): import "./globals.css"; Copy For Vite/React: Import in your main entry file (main.tsx or index.tsx): import "./index.css"; Copy Using ODS Tokens with Tailwind Once configured, you can use ODS design tokens through Tailwind utilities: Colors

Troubleshooting Styles not applying Ensure PostCSS is configured correctly Verify the global CSS file is imported in your application entry point Check that the build tool supports CSS @import statements Token conflicts If you're using the full.css preset and experiencing conflicts: ODS tokens use semantic names (bg-accent, text-basic) Tailwind defaults use color scales (bg-blue-500, text-red-400) Use ODS tokens for design system compliance Build errors Ensure you have compatible versions: Tailwind CSS v4.2.4 or higher @tailwindcss/postcss v4.2.4 or higher @telekom-ods/design-tokens v2.0.0 or higher Next Steps Check out Tailwind CSS v4 documentation Review the ODS Design Guidelines Credits Special thanks to the OneTaskPlatform team for making this integration possible. We especially appreciate Felix Schneider for his contributions and support in developing this community-driven package. Need Help? If you encounter any issues or have questions, please visit the support page or reach out to the community maintainer Felix Schneider.
